text:
公司去年招了一个86年的技术专家，当时HR还犹豫，说年龄有点大，老板坚持要，说这个人技术强，能带团队。来了之后确实厉害，帮公司解决了好几个技术难题，带的新人也成长很快。我们都觉得这钱花得值。

结果上周，老板找他说要降薪30%，理由是公司困难，希望大家共渡难关。他不同意，说要么按合同来，要么他走。老板说那你自己考虑吧。他考虑了三天，走了。

他走的那天，跟我们说，当初来的时候，老板说得好听，什么技术带头人，什么核心骨干，什么长期发展。

现在公司稍微有点困难，第一个拿我开刀。他说你们记住，在大厂也好，在小厂也好，你永远是一个数字，不是一个人。

text:
1997 年 WWDC，台下有个开发者当着全场人的面给乔布斯难堪：

“你很聪明，也很有影响力。但很遗憾，好几个关键问题上，你根本不知道自己在讲什么。”

全场瞬间死寂。
对方甚至当场补刀：你打算怎么用 Java 承接 OpenDoc？你过去这几年到底都在干什么？

乔布斯没有急着反唇相讥。
他低头沉默了很久，拧开水瓶慢慢喝了一口，才拿起话筒。

那段封神的 5 分钟回应里，有三点非常值得所有人学习：

1. 最难受的现实在于：当众挑战你的这帮人，在具体的局部细节上往往是对的。

2. 必须从用户体验倒推技术实现，绝不能拿着手里现成的锤子到处找钉子。

3. 这种错误他犯得比在座所有人都多，身上全是疤；苹果要活下去，很多哪怕再精巧的技术，也只能沦为断臂求生的代价。

很多人把这段封神现场当成以客户为中心的励志鸡汤，其实看浅了。

乔布斯赢的从来不是辩才，而是认知维度的降维打击：

他先大方承认对方在技术上完全合理，然后不动声色地把整场对话的战场换掉了：从乔布斯懂不懂技术细节，直接切换成苹果到底要砍掉什么才能活下去。

聚焦从来不是做加法，而是冷酷地做减法。敢对无数个局部正确的技术说不，才能收敛出一台能卖几十亿的成熟产品。

在众目睽睽下被当头泼冷水，还能不被情绪带偏、瞬间把议题拉回生死线，这才是顶级掌舵人的抗压底色。

在商业战场上，赢下技术争辩毫无意义。

最惨烈的死法，莫过于公司彻底破产了，而你手里的技术每一行都是对的。

text:
老婆洗澡时，她男上司发来消息：“宝贝儿，真想吃掉你！”我替她回了：“他不在家，赶紧来。”然后坐在沙发上等。

后槽牙咬得咯吱响。浴室里她还在哼歌。我回完消息，把水果刀搁沙发垫下，坐等。

七八分钟门铃响。猫眼里一个油头灰夹克，拎着纸袋——正是她手机里备注的“王总”。我拉开门缝，他笑僵了：“那个……拿份文件。”我指纸袋：“拿文件配巧克力？”他耳朵红了。

老婆裹浴巾出来，浴巾差点没抓住：“你咋来了？”纸袋掉地，滚出巧克力和一条没拆吊牌的丝巾。她蹲下捡，我踩住丝巾：“啥文件配这个？”她瞪我：“你翻我手机了？”我说：“没翻，它自己亮的。”

王总整领子装硬：“兄弟，误会，普通上下级……”我打断：“普通上下级叫宝贝儿？大晚上往人家里跑？”我抽出水果刀往茶几上一拍。他腿抖，捡起纸袋连滚带爬下楼。

她哭着回卧室，门摔得震天响。我给我妈发语音：“明天我接孩子，先别让娃回来。”

十来分钟后她出来，眼睛肿着，手里攥着手机：“他刚发消息，说明天调我走，去外地。”我说：“调呗。”她说：“你咋这么冷静？”我说：“我差点进去蹲着。”她哭：“你想咋办？”我说：“明天该上班上班，就说你老公在家。但从明天起下班直接回家，晚一分钟我去公司楼下等。”

第二天茶几上丝巾没了，多了张纸条：“我调岗了，下周去仓库。”字歪歪扭扭。她真去了，天天准时回家，做饭洗衣。可我再没碰过她手机，她也没让我碰过。半夜醒来她背对我肩膀一抽一抽，我也不问。

换你，当没发生过，还是非离了才算完？

text:
病床前的温柔：1998年，莱昂纳多与17岁桑兰
40分钟

1998年7月，纽约。
17岁中国体操小将桑兰在友好运动会热身时意外重伤，
颈椎肯折导致高位截瘫。
在漫长而痛苦的治疗期间，
一个看似遥不可及的心愿达成，
为这位花季少女的至暗时刻注入了一束温暖的光。

意外发生后，
桑兰的病情牵动着无数人的心。
在医院治疗期间，
当身边的人问起她有没有想见人时，
这位正承受着巨大伤痛的少女，
轻声说出了一个名字——因电影《泰坦尼克号》爆火全球的莱昂纳多・迪卡普里奥。

彼时，
莱昂纳多正值演艺事业的顶峰，
行程极为紧凑。
然而，
在得知桑兰心愿后，
他欣然应允。

为了不打扰病房的宁静，
也为了避开媒体长枪短炮，
他极其低调地带看一名保镖，
悄然来到了桑兰的病房。

没有闪光灯的喧嚣，
只有最真诚的关切。
在病床边，莱昂纳多俯下身，
眼神温柔地注视着这位勇敢的女孩，
他的手轻轻抚摸看她的头发（如图）。

两人交谈了约40分钟，
莱昂纳多不仅真诚地夸赞桑兰勇敢坚强，
还特意带来了一盘《泰坦尼克号》的录像带，并留下了自己的通讯地址。

照片定格了这温馨的一幕：
戴着颈椎固定器的桑兰露出了灿烂的笑容，

17岁中国体操小将桑兰在友好运动会热身时意外重伤，
颈椎肯折导致高位截瘫。
在漫长而痛苦的治疗期间，
一个看似遥不可及的心愿达成，
为这位花季少女的至暗时刻注入了一束温暖的光。

意外发生后，
桑兰的病情牵动着无数人的心。
在医院治疗期间，
当身边的人问起她有没有想见人时，
这位正承受着巨大伤痛的少女，
轻声说出了一个名字——因电影《泰坦尼克号》爆火全球的莱昂纳多・迪卡普里奥。

彼时，
莱昂纳多正值演艺事业的顶峰，
行程极为紧凑。
然而，
在得知桑兰心愿后，
他欣然应允。

为了不打扰病房的宁静，
也为了避开媒体长枪短炮，
他极其低调地带看一名保镖，
悄然来到了桑兰的病房。

没有闪光灯的喧嚣，
只有最真诚的关切。
在病床边，莱昂纳多俯下身，
眼神温柔地注视着这位勇敢的女孩，
他的手轻轻抚摸看她的头发（如图）。

两人交谈了约40分钟，
莱昂纳多不仅真诚地夸赞桑兰勇敢坚强，
还特意带来了一盘《泰坦尼克号》的录像带，并留下了自己的通讯地址。

照片定格了这温馨的一幕：
戴着颈椎固定器的桑兰露出了灿烂的笑容，
而这位国际巨星的眼神中满是暖意。

modal gives every account $30 of GPU compute a month for free. that's 12 hours on an A100 80GB, or ~6.6 on an H200, billed per second.

the move: host your own open model as an openai-compatible API and point your coding agent at it.

1. sign up at https://t.co/W0Hie739um (github login works), starter plan is $0
2. pip install modal && modal setup
3. git clone https://t.co/qzOb5tfsD3
4. modal deploy modal-examples/06_gpu_and_ml/llm-serving/vllm_inference.py
5. it prints a URL. add /v1 and it's an openai-style endpoint serving gemma 4 26B on vLLM
6. add it as an openai-compatible provider in opencode, cline, or whatever you use

it scales to zero. no requests = no GPU bill.

catch: it stays warm 15 min after the last request, and that idle time eats credits. the example endpoint is unauthenticated, so add auth before you share the URL. a card is required, and anything past $30 gets billed.

what model would you host first?

text:
Elon 又双叒叕对太空芯片散热一事发飙了。。。

出于好奇，我问了 AI 这个问题：

太空中如果芯片不方便散热的话，能不能反过来操作，耗费能源来制冷？

结果背后的物理逻辑还挺反直觉的 —— 答案是：能，但耗电不是为了“消灭”热量，而是为了给热量“升压”。

1. 为什么不能直接耗电“抵消”热量？

   首先，物理世界里根本没有“制造冷气”这回事。不管是空调还是冰箱，本质上都只是热量的“搬运工”。

   如果你把家里的门窗封死，再把冰箱门敞开，房间不但不会变凉，反而会越来越热 —— 因为冰箱压缩机干活时自己也在发热。

   太空是真空环境，就像一个天然的超级保温杯。如果只耗电制冷，却不把热量扔出去，耗的电只会变成额外的废热，让卫星烤熟得更快。

2. 既然总热量变多了，耗电制冷有什么用？

   在太空中，没有空气给你吹风散热，排热的唯一办法是靠物体自己“发光”（热辐射） —— 也就是让散热板往宇宙发射红外线。

   但这里有个死结：芯片很娇气，超过七八十度就会死机；而在七八十度下，散热板向外辐射热量的速度慢得像蜗牛。如果想直接散掉太空机房的热量，得给卫星背上一块大得离谱的散热板。

3. 破局外挂：温度的“四次方定律”

   宇宙里有一条物理铁律：物体热辐射的速度，和它绝对温度的“四次方”成正比。

   什么概念？只要把散热板的绝对温度提高 1.5 倍，它的散热速度不是快 1.5 倍，而是直接暴涨 5 倍（1.5 × 1.5 × 1.5 × 1.5 ≈ 5.06）！

这就是太空中“耗电制冷”真正的妙用：
工程师用太空中廉价的太阳能发电，驱动热泵，强行把芯片上七八十度的热量抽出来，“压缩升温”到两三百度，再灌进外面的散热板里。

虽然这中间多耗了点电、总废热增加了一点，但因为散热板变得滚烫，它往宇宙深空“喷射”热量的效率翻了好几倍，所需的散热板面积瞬间就能砍掉大半。

一句话总结：

太空里耗能制冷，不是为了凭空变出冷气，而是像水泵加压一样 —— 用太空中不要钱的阳光（电能），把芯片的低温热量压缩成高温热量，借用“四次方定律”的物理外挂，高效地轰进宇宙里。🛰️

平时正价在土区也要 8999 里拉（约合 1200+ 元），美区更是直接抢劫 $200 的 Google AI Ultra 20X（30TB 顶配），现在疑似出现苹果内购隐藏漏洞！只需 410 块人民币（2949 里拉）就能直接拿下！

比起现在天天降智、还把网页和 Codex 额度合并的 OpenAI，谷歌这波历史隐藏促销漏洞可以说是诚意满满。漏洞随时可能被修复，想上车的抓紧看以下实操全流程：

核心实操全流程（建议先码后看，一步都不能错）：

前期准备： 准备一个土区 Apple ID，并充值土区礼品卡（走平台 3000 里拉大约 61 USDC，折合人民币 410 左右）。

账号要求： Google 账号不限地区，但必须是带有折扣的新号。

关键应用： 使用 iOS 设备下载 Google App（注意：必须是 Google App，绝对不能用 Google One，这一步千万不能错）。

触发漏洞： 在 Google App 内部默认不会展示 20X 套餐。你需要先走内购，随便开通一个带折扣的基础套餐。
寻找隐藏入口： 基础套餐开通后，直接切到 iOS 系统的【设置】 -> 【Apple ID】 -> 【订阅】 -> 找到你的 Google 订阅。

展开促销组： 展开隐藏的“intro offer group”并点击“see all plans”。

锁定 30TB 目标： 在最后升级的列表里面，你会同时刷出两个 30TB Ultra，一个是现价 8999 里拉，另一个直接就是 2949 里拉！注意多翻找一下，这个特价的 Google AI Ultra (30 TB) 选项可能会混在一堆 Google AI Plus 的列表里面。1000026033.jpg

确认订阅： 找到 ₺2.949,99 的选项，直接点进去确认订阅，大功告成！1000026033.jpg

趁着这个苹果订阅系统里的历史隐藏促销组还没下架，手慢无，要冲的速去！

朋友借我车，回来时把油加满了，还洗得干干净净。

我挺不好意思，说就用一天，没必要这么客气。

我说可以。

我越想越觉得这朋友能处。

我开玩笑说，那我以后可没免费洗车了。

他笑了笑。

“我也终于不用每次接女朋友，都先把你车里的儿童座椅搬下来了。”

text:
Sam Altman 前阵子说，每个人电脑里都放着一堆内存，可能只有 5% 的时间在用，从全球分配的角度看，“挺糟糕的”。

Reddit 上有个哥们接了这个挑战。

他的配置：
RX 9070 XT 16G 游戏显卡
5800X3D 的 CPU
64G DDR4，按现在的内存价格，这几根条子比电脑其他部件加起来还贵
一块 PCIe 3.0 的老 SSD

跑 DeepSeek V4.1 Flash，1M 上下文，1.75 bit 量化，完全离线。
显存、内存、硬盘三层一起放模型。

出字 7 token/s，够用。
难受的是开头：每开一个新的 Agent 编程会话，都要把 3.7 万 token 的系统提示词重读一遍，等 100 秒才出第一个字。

他改了引擎，两刀。

第一刀我觉得最值得讲。
Agent 会把日期、工作目录、项目说明、带随机 ID 的路径，塞进系统提示词。
缓存按前缀匹配，开头变了几个字，后面全部作废。
所以每次新会话都是冷启动，3.7 万 token 从头读。
他让引擎把新提示词和存下来的旧会话逐行对齐，变了的那几行剪掉重读，其余直接复用。

第二刀：MoE 模型哪怕只读一小段输入，也会碰到几乎每层的每个专家。
1200 token 的提示词，从硬盘拉了 58G 数据。这个数字有点离谱。
他改成读提示词时只用已经在显存和内存里的专家，生成回答时照常路由。

结果，Agent 会话启动快了 20 倍。

边界他自己也写清楚了：
只在 AMD 卡上测过，N 卡没试；
剪接是近似做法，没做正式评测；
换专家会让答案略有变化，他的编程测试两种方式都是 12/13，但各只跑了一次。

我觉得这事最有意思的地方是：
家里那几根内存闲着，很大一部分原因在软件。
很多推理软件没按家用机器的约束认真抠过，一个人抠一抠，就是 20 倍。

顺手带走一条：自己写 Agent 提示词，会变的东西（日期、路径这些）尽量往后放，开头保持一字不差，缓存才吃得到。调云端 API 也一样，省的是真钱。

他最后给 Sam 贴了张利用率截图：显存满的，内存满的，SSD 满速在跑。
说整台机器唯一闲着的部件，是他的钱包。

要不我也囤几根内存条，对冲一下 Sam 算了。

https://t.co/aYWtHtzDrS

Last night, my lawyers moved to sanction World Liberty Financial @worldlibertyfi for failing to disclose, until months into my litigation against the company, that it is a citizen of the UAE 🇦🇪 . #WLFI #USD1 

For those who are new to this dispute, I was one of World Liberty’s earliest and largest investors.  In November 2024, I agreed to buy $30 million of $WLFI tokens under a Token Purchase Agreement with World Liberty, and I later increased my total investment to $45 million. 

In April, I sued World Liberty, alleging that the company induced my investment through fraud and then unlawfully froze my tokens.

My Token Purchase Agreement gives me the right to bring my claims in either California federal or state court.  

I chose federal court.

Federal courts can hear a case like mine only when the two sides come from different places.  Foreign plaintiffs like me can sue an American defendant in federal court, but foreign plaintiffs generally cannot sue a foreign defendant there.  For these purposes, a company like World Liberty takes on the citizenship of each of its owners, so a single foreign owner makes the company foreign.  

In other words, so long as World Liberty and all of its owners were American, my case could be heard in federal court.

The federal court’s rules required World Liberty to file a disclosure at the start of the case identifying every one of its owners and where each is a citizen.  World Liberty’s disclosure identified only one entity—World Liberty itself—and listed Florida as its sole citizenship.  Its lawyers certified that they were unaware of anyone else who needed to be disclosed.

World Liberty then moved to compel arbitration, seeking to pull my case out of open court and into secret arbitration proceedings. 

I opposed that motion, and my lawyers spent months and hundreds of thousands of dollars fighting it.  At a hearing in August, the Court signaled that it was not persuaded that my claims belonged in arbitration.  Instead, the Court ruled that certain of my claims should stay in open court, and certain claims should be sent to arbitration, and ordered the parties to meet and confer to come up with a proposed agreement on which claims stay in open court and which ones go to arbitration.

Less than a week later, World Liberty suddenly “corrected” its disclosure.  Where it had previously listed only one member in its ownership chain, it now listed 22, and claimed citizenship in Florida, Delaware, Puerto Rico, and the UAE.  

World Liberty now says that the federal court has no jurisdiction over my case, since its UAE citizenship means there are foreign parties on both sides of the case.

The irony is hard to miss.  World Liberty’s gold paper declares that “[b]y design, World Liberty Financial is not organized offshore,” and that it is “an American, tax-paying, corporation that aims to bring DeFi to its rightful home—America.”  It promises a “US-based decentralized platform” built on “American ideals of liberty, privacy, and freedom to transact,” calls private, intermediary-free transactions “a core American value,” and boasts that “[r]ather than shying away from the United States, World Liberty Financial embraces the United States as the future CRYPTO CAPITAL OF THE PLANET.”

World Liberty was proudly American 🇺🇸 when it was selling tokens.  It discovered its UAE 🇦🇪 roots only when it needed a way out of an American federal courtroom.

World Liberty presumably always knew who its owners were.  Its lawyers claim that they learned about the company’s UAE citizenship only after they filed the original disclosure.  

As my motion explains, if that is true, then either World Liberty’s lawyers failed to conduct appropriate diligence, or World Liberty did not give its lawyers a straight answer.  When we asked how this happened, World Liberty refused to tell us.

Token holders deserve to know whether the projects they invest in are telling the truth, both to the public and to courts.  I am filing this motion to hold World Liberty and its lawyers accountable for what I believe was a misleading disclosure to the Court, and to make sure that the cost of World Liberty’s gamesmanship falls on them, not on me.  

And after my sanctions motion is resolved in federal court, I will re-file my lawsuit against World Liberty in California state court.

I will keep fighting for the transparency this community deserves.

text:
一位系统管理员病逝后，不懂技术的妻子来 Reddit 感谢网友帮她拆掉满屋服务器，并决定自己去学 IT
几个月前，Reddit 的系统管理员社区（r/sysadmin）来了一位特殊的求助者。她的丈夫是一名资深系统管理员（SysAdmin），当时正因重病躺在医院里搏斗。为了搬到离医院更近的地方照顾他，完全不懂技术的妻子必须拆掉丈夫在家里衣帽间搭建的一整套复杂服务器机柜（Homelab），但她面对满屋子的网线、机架和设备无从下手，生怕不小心弄坏了丈夫的心血。
11 月 1 日，这位妻子（ID：icsk8grrl）回到社区发了一篇后续帖。她在帖子里说，丈夫在 ICU 住了大约两个月后还是不幸离世了，但万幸的是，他在离开前从人工诱导昏迷中醒了过来，全家人一起陪刚满 3 岁的女儿过了生日。
去世前几天，因为丈夫身体太虚弱，连距离医院只有 8 分钟车程的家都回不去。夜班护士悄悄协调了好几个医疗小组，推着全套维生设备和便携呼吸机，把他带到了医院大门外。在仅有的 10 分钟里，他最后看了一眼夜空，3 岁的女儿指着天上的月亮和金星给他看，他对着女儿露出了灿烂的笑容。
【留给家人的机柜与温情】
在这个经常自嘲“打工人随时会被公司轻易替代”的论坛里，这位妻子特意提到了丈夫生前的两家雇主。她说，丈夫的前东家提供了巨大的帮助，而现任雇主在他患病的 3 年里极其慷慨和体贴，最后还专程来参加了葬礼，“和我们一起痛哭”。
而在网友的指点和帮忙下，她找人安全拆掉了那套紧挨着热水器、装在发烧友级 SilverStone 机箱里的家庭服务器，把所有零件分类贴好了标签，只留下衣帽间地板上“5 万颗散落的随机螺丝”。现在，她正在新家清理衣帽间，准备把丈夫生前躺在病床上从二手市场淘来的 9U 小机柜重新装起来。
因为丈夫生前最常潜水逛的就是这个版块，她决定去报一些基础的 IT 课程，至少学会自己更新设备、做好日常网络安全，甚至打算接过丈夫的班：“也许 5 到 10 年后，我也会作为一名系统管理员回到这里。又或者 20 年后，回来的是我们的孩子。”
这周，他们 3 岁的女儿人生第一次尝试玩电脑游戏，自己学会了用方向键、鼠标、数字键和空格键玩《星露谷物语》（Stardew Valley），而且已经学会在睡觉时间为了多玩一会儿跟妈妈讨价还价了。妻子在评论区里还半开玩笑地向网友倒苦水：丈夫生前精通西班牙语，留下一堆没贴标签的神秘 U 盘不敢乱插，还有一个保持了 1780 天的多邻国（Duolingo）打卡纪录，完全不懂西语的她现在每天都在拼命帮他续火苗。
【给所有技术人员的托付】
在帖子的最后，她给所有习惯在家里折腾复杂网络和设备的工程师留了一段很实在的提醒：
“友情提醒大家：去买份人寿保险，准备一个密码管理器，并把主密码共享给你的伴侣或直系亲属。另外，请一定要提前聊聊那些沉重的话题——比如维生支持要用哪种、维持多久，选火葬还是土葬，如果有告别仪式你想穿什么衣服、放什么音乐。”
评论区里，成百上千名平时只聊服务器宕机、漏洞补丁和裁员的系统管理员纷纷破防致敬。有人借用《星际牛仔》的台词向他道别，也有人写下了一句属于老网管的祝福：“他现在去了一个网线永远按颜色对齐、没有打印机故障、DNS 也永远不会挂掉的地方。”

text:
🤯逆天了！Qwen 3.8 27B注意力层被彻底击穿了！10M超长上下文下，Prefill注意力快72.4倍、Decode快42.5倍！端到端首token延迟砍到约1/9！

闲置GPU的朋友注意了：把这个新方法丢给Claude/Codex，让它直接移植到Qwen 27B上！注意力算法“移植”已经被验证可行。

惊人之处：
🔹10M token（约1000万）超长上下文下，传统稀疏注意力有98%时间都在“找该看哪些token”，真正算注意力反而没那么贵

🔹新方法Latent Sparse Attention (LSA)：先把Key按“意思相近”聚类成层级结构，Query只看聚类中心，再挑最相关的几个桶去算。从“全扫”变成“树搜索”

🔹实测（Qwen-3.8-27B）：单层注意力Prefill快72.4倍，Decode快42.5倍！端到端首token延迟也能降到约1/9

🔹精度几乎不掉，甚至在RULER等长上下文任务上还略好一点

🔹只需要短蒸馏训练Indexer（基座模型冻结），就能套到现成模型上。Native训练版本也能跟上全注意力精度，还更快

🔹对GPU紧缺党意义巨大：超长上下文（百万级）不再需要堆满H100/H200才能跑，单卡/少量卡也能玩得起真正长上下文Agent

适配步骤：
1️⃣git clone 仓库后用 uv sync 安装（Python 3.12）

2️⃣官方已放出Qwen3.8-27B的蒸馏权重（d-lsa-weights-v1 release），直接下载即可

3️⃣用他们的SGLang fork镜像启动服务，挂载仓库+权重

🔹新方法Latent Sparse Attention (LSA)：先把Key按“意思相近”聚类成层级结构，Query只看聚类中心，再挑最相关的几个桶去算。从“全扫”变成“树搜索”

🔹只需要短蒸馏训练Indexer（基座模型冻结），就能套到现成模型上。Native训练版本也能跟上全注意力精度，还更快

text:
别再沉迷让 Sub-agent 互相 Review 代码了——你以为是“左脚踩右脚上天”，其实是“左手掏右手钱包”。🔥🤖

太赞同 poteto 小姐姐今天的说法了！！

她直言对抗式代码审查（Adversarial Review）大多是在纯烧 Token，不仅大幅砍掉了 pstack 里的 interrogate 技能，还打算把省下的算力全砸向“实测 + 形式化验证”。

跑过自动化 Agent 工作流的人都懂，静态的 AI 代码互审有三个近乎无解的死穴：

▸ 没苦硬吃：Reviewer 为了证明自己“干活了”，没 Bug 也要硬挑一堆可有可无的代码风格问题（Nitpicking）。
▸ 过度设计（YAGNI）：为了应付 Reviewer 脑补出来的“极端假设”，主 Agent 会疯狂往代码里塞毫无必要的抽象层和防御逻辑，越改越臃肿，上下文越滚越脏。
▸ 算力错配：用最贵的推理 Token 去“猜”代码会不会报错，却不用免费的编译器和 Linter 去直接跑一下。

一边是 xAI 工程师砍掉模型互撕、回归硬核验证；另一边是今天 OpenAI 和 Muse 狂提赏金、直接花钱买外部黑客打系统找 Bug。

顶级团队都在用行动投票：两个大模型在终端里吵一万句，不如测试框架红一次，更不如真实红队来一拳。

你的工作流里，AI 审查员到底是在帮你抓真漏洞，还是在帮你刷 API 账单？

quotedTweet.text:
maybe a hot take but i now consider adversarial reviews mostly a waste of tokens. far better to use those tokens on empirical combined with formal verification. i have updated pstack to use the interrogate skill less, and eventually i think i may remove it altogether

i have found very little value with code review in the abstract, agents tend to just get lost in the nitpicks and yagnis

As AI becomes more capable at finding vulnerabilities, defenders need to put it to work before attackers do.

We’re planning our next internal security sprint at OpenAI and partnering with Cathedral Systems, whose researchers will use our models alongside our teams to challenge our defenses. They’ll bring differentiated expertise and approaches to our ongoing work to find and fix weaknesses with AI.

quotedTweet.text:
Most people are still using AI the wrong way.

They ask it questions.

Elon Musk just pointed at the right way.

Yesterday, Jason Ginsberg wrote: "Treat Grok Bot like a teammate and give @bot an ambitious task you'd normally give to a new hire."

Elon's answer: "This is the way."

Three words. A whole shift in how we work.

Here's what that looks like in real life.

Scott Billows runs a business with a very traditional sales cycle. Deals that take months to cultivate.

He pointed Grok Bot at his company's tools.

It dug through the past. Surfaced old prospects and customers nobody was calling anymore. Handed them to his sales reps.

Two weeks in, a closed deal.

His words: "Without Grok Bot we most likely would not have reached out to this past customer."

Think about that.

Not a faster search. Not a smarter autocomplete. Not a chatbot.

A teammate that found money hiding in plain sight.

Everyone thought AI would be a better answer machine.

It's actually a new kind of colleague.

Elon put it plainly back in October: "assume you are hiring a super competent employee."

Not a tool you open. Someone you hand the job to.

The team keeps adding powers. Product pages. Order tracking. Payments. Team Bots your whole company can share.

Every week the job description gets longer.

Here's the part almost nobody sees yet.

For all of history, having a team was a privilege. Only the rich, the big companies, the well-connected could delegate.

Everyone else did everything alone.

That wall is falling.

A small shop owner. A single parent. A sailor at sea. Anyone can now say: "Here's the mission. Go."

When everyone gets a team, everyone becomes a builder.

And a civilization of builders doesn't stay small for long.

Stop asking AI questions.

Give it a job.

text:
狗头萝莉刚提一周的小米汽车，就被人砸了

11月2日，狗头萝莉到广州参加完生日会，因为订的酒店便宜、没有车库，就把刚提一周的小米澎程停在路边。

结果被人拿一块板砖，把车身从头划到尾。这辆被她称为"大狗"的新车，如今身上多了一道抹不掉的疤。事后她报了警。

七天。从提车到划痕，只有七天。

为什么被砸？她没跟谁结仇，问题大概率出在这辆车上。近几个月，小米车主被泼粪、被踹门、被划车的事件接连发生，受害者互不相识，唯一的共同点：车是小米。

砸车的人砸的其实不是车，是一个符号。

车圈饭圈化之后，有些人把品牌当成自己的阵营，对手卖得好，就等于自己输了。

可他们够不着车企，也够不着厂家，只能对路边一辆无人看守的新车下手——报复不了资本，就报复同为普通人的车主。

说到底，这不是维权，是泄愤。

text:
【讨个请教】各位 Agent 大神是怎么管理如此多的 Session x Agent 对话的消息的？

我现在同时会有多个Session x Antigravity/Claude Code/Codex。

为了知道每个任务进度，我目前采用的是飞书消息，设定了全局的规则当某个 Session 完成的时候，给我发消息。

但目前我有两个痛点：
1. 飞书消息并不能很的回溯到对应 Agent的Session（指直接跳转），也不能标记任务状态
2. 当有多个Session同时完成时，我像个指针在遍历分时多任务。

2026年底了，有没有一些优雅的方案，我希望本地有一个类似 Grok Bot 的主 Bot 帮我管理对话、进度和派发的产品（但不是Grok Bot），我不想像一个指针在一直遍历各个对话。

text: World Liberty was proudly American 🇺🇸 when it was selling tokens.  It discovered its UAE 🇦🇪 roots only when it needed a way out of an American federal courtroom.

quotedTweet.text:
Last night, my lawyers moved to sanction World Liberty Financial @worldlibertyfi for failing to disclose, until months into my litigation against the company, that it is a citizen of the UAE 🇦🇪 . #WLFI #USD1 

For those who are new to this dispute, I was one of World Liberty’s earliest and largest investors.  In November 2024, I agreed to buy $30 million of $WLFI tokens under a Token Purchase Agreement with World Liberty, and I later increased my total investment to $45 million. 

In April, I sued World Liberty, alleging that the company induced my investment through fraud and then unlawfully froze my tokens.

My Token Purchase Agreement gives me the right to bring my claims in either California federal or state court.  

I chose federal court.

Federal courts can hear a case like mine only when the two sides come from different places.  Foreign plaintiffs like me can sue an American defendant in federal court, but foreign plaintiffs generally cannot sue a foreign defendant there.  For these purposes, a company like World Liberty takes on the citizenship of each of its owners, so a single foreign owner makes the company foreign.  

In other words, so long as World Liberty and all of its owners were American, my case could be heard in federal court.

The federal court’s rules required World Liberty to file a disclosure at the start of the case identifying every one of its owners and where each is a citizen.  World Liberty’s disclosure identified only one entity—World Liberty itself—and listed Florida as its sole citizenship.  Its lawyers certified that they were unaware of anyone else who needed to be disclosed.

World Liberty then moved to compel arbitration, seeking to pull my case out of open court and into secret arbitration proceedings. 

I opposed that motion, and my lawyers spent months and hundreds of thousands of dollars fighting it.  At a hearing in August, the Court signaled that it was not persuaded that my claims belonged in arbitration.  Instead, the Court ruled that certain of my claims should stay in open court, and certain claims should be sent to arbitration, and ordered the parties to meet and confer to come up with a proposed agreement on which claims stay in open court and which ones go to arbitration.

Less than a week later, World Liberty suddenly “corrected” its disclosure.  Where it had previously listed only one member in its ownership chain, it now listed 22, and claimed citizenship in Florida, Delaware, Puerto Rico, and the UAE.  

World Liberty now says that the federal court has no jurisdiction over my case, since its UAE citizenship means there are foreign parties on both sides of the case.

The irony is hard to miss.  World Liberty’s gold paper declares that “[b]y design, World Liberty Financial is not organized offshore,” and that it is “an American, tax-paying, corporation that aims to bring DeFi to its rightful home—America.”  It promises a “US-based decentralized platform” built on “American ideals of liberty, privacy, and freedom to transact,” calls private, intermediary-free transactions “a core American value,” and boasts that “[r]ather than shying away from the United States, World Liberty Financial embraces the United States as the future CRYPTO CAPITAL OF THE PLANET.”

World Liberty was proudly American 🇺🇸 when it was selling tokens.  It discovered its UAE 🇦🇪 roots only when it needed a way out of an American federal courtroom.

World Liberty presumably always knew who its owners were.  Its lawyers claim that they learned about the company’s UAE citizenship only after they filed the original disclosure.  

As my motion explains, if that is true, then either World Liberty’s lawyers failed to conduct appropriate diligence, or World Liberty did not give its lawyers a straight answer.  When we asked how this happened, World Liberty refused to tell us.

Token holders deserve to know whether the projects they invest in are telling the truth, both to the public and to courts.  I am filing this motion to hold World Liberty and its lawyers accountable for what I believe was a misleading disclosure to the Court, and to make sure that the cost of World Liberty’s gamesmanship falls on them, not on me.  

And after my sanctions motion is resolved in federal court, I will re-file my lawsuit against World Liberty in California state court.

I will keep fighting for the transparency this community deserves.

text:
Back in May, oil collapsed into a market loaded with bullish exposure. Falling prices created forced sellers, and that liquidation helped turn a correction into a massacre. Today, oil is back near the same price zone, but the ownership structure is completely different. The bulls never returned, net positioning remains near the July washout, and gross shorts are at a five-year extreme. That does not mean oil cannot fall on a peace agreement—but it does mean weakness may increasingly create buyers through short covering rather than another wave of long liquidation. Positioning may not determine oil’s destination, but it can dramatically change the speed and violence of the journey.

柴静是一个冷静的记者，在我看来，这是她唯一失态的一次讲访。

话题围绕2009年哥本哈根气候大会后“什么是公平的减排方案”。

丁仲礼：中国政府应该制定一个雄心勃勃的长期排放承诺，就是一句话——从1990年到2050年，中国的人均排放量坚决不超过发达国家同期水平的80%。不管你怎么减排，我都要比你少，而且我一定要做到。发达国家基础设施已经建完了，中国很多还没有建，在这样的发展阶段下，中国应该提出这样的方案，让全世界看到我们在应对气候变化上比你们雄心勃勃得多。

柴静：那他会觉得说，中国是个人口大国，你这么一乘的话那个基数太大了。
丁仲礼：那么我就要问你了，中国人是不是人？这就是一个根本的问题了。为什么同样的一个中国人就应该少排？你这个是以国家为单位算的，还是以人为单位算的？

柴静：那他会觉得说，现在常规都是以国算。

丁仲礼：那我没必要跟你算了。摩纳哥多少人？我们中国跟摩纳哥比行不行？还讲不讲理了？

A few teams are already doing interesting things here, and I think we have something to contribute...especially with all the pricing data and collection tools we’ve already been building

This will be one of my focuses over the next couple of quarters, alongside Before the Slab, Riftbound deck building, and eventually the JK Index mobile app

Still early, plenty to figure out, but I really like the idea

Slowly but surely, we keep going 🫡

Also still hunting for a social media intern, DMs open if you have any references!

- Use the 2 Up set to create a strong baseline passing opportunity and put immediate pressure on the defense near the basket.

- Position a strong finisher as the primary interior target, giving the inbounder a reliable option around the rim.

- Space shooters around the action to prevent help defenders from collapsing into the paint and taking away the inside option.

- Make the baseline pass on time when the defender is sealed, allowing the receiver to catch in a position where they can finish quickly.

- Run the action with pace and physicality so the screening, sealing, and cuts happen decisively before the defense has time to recover.

text:
🔥把最近几天 OpenAI 的几个大动作串起来看，得出一个结论：11 月大概率是今年最适合开 ChatGPT Pro 的一个月了（哪怕你只打算体验这一个月，下个月不续费都值）。

原因很现实，官方用一套组合拳把 Pro 的含金量拉到了顶峰，同时堵死了换号平替的路子：
1.  多号流被堵死：刚出的 Card & Device 限制直接针对“同设备登录多个付费号”。以前额度不够买几个 Plus 成品号来回切的做法，现在不仅麻烦（得搞指纹浏览器或虚拟机），还极易触发风控，带来限流降智。

2. 🌟Pro 额度直接翻倍 + 送重置卡：原本的阶梯直接翻倍到了 10x / 20x / 50x，这两天还连发两张额度重置卡，算力彻底管够。

3. 🌟白嫖官方 API 积分：现在 Pro 订满 7 天就能在 Billing 里领免费 API 额度，直接调 gpt-5.6、跑 Agent、接自己的脚本全都能抵扣，相当于官方变相给你返现。

4. 12月改版前的绝唱：最关键的一点——12 月份开始，日常聊天和 Work / Codex 就要合并共享额度了。这意味着 11 月是两边额度独立核算的最后一个爽月。

所以最聪明的策略就是：趁这个月福利叠满先冲一个月 Pro 把手头的重活干完，至于 12 月共享额度后还值不值得续，下个月再看。

今天店里 Pro 档位正好全线调低了一波价格（菲区 Plus 也能直接无缝升级），全系正规官充通道我整理在一楼评论区了👇

text:
初中的时候，班里有个智力有些缺陷的女生，平时大家都喜欢欺负她。

那时我也不是啥好人，脾气差，喜欢打架。

有一天，我忽然觉得她很可怜，没人敢冲我发脾气，但是谁都能欺负她。

慢慢地，我开始帮她收拾东西，她情绪失控的时候打骂我几下也任由她。
再到后面，哪怕别人对她有一点言语，我都上去一个大嘴巴子，把那几个爱闹事的拉出来打。

因为我成绩好，老师都是睁一只眼闭一只眼，口头教育。再加上对方也不敢还手，算不上打架斗殴。

初中三年，不长的光景，我尽量让她过得正常，因为我清楚，她上不了高中，这或许是她最后的学生时光。

text:
Part 2 of GPU financing blog post is up!

TLDR:

• Instead of clarifying things, I muddle them up even more by introducing equine residual value curves (and why I'm cooked)
• Cost of maintenance vs. cost of the hard asset
• Pooling and diversification as a way to hedge tenant risk (e.g. SASB CMBS vs. credit card ABS)
• Moving away from GPU modularity worsens residual value risk -> but we might be going back to modular! 
• Literally no one is doing the one thing that every other ABS deal requires you to do. 

And thanks @chamath for the nod on Part 1 :)

quotedTweet.text:
A lot of ink has been spilled on GPU financing lately. I spent over a decade trading ABS on Wall St, and structured over $2B+ of debt financings as an operator (including at @tryramp). Figured I'd try to make sense of this market, so I went back to a framework I knew well: aircraft ABS and aircraft engine ABS.

My take: a GPU neocloud runs on airline economics, and the debt behind it looks a lot like aircraft engine ABS.

The parallels:

• Perishable inventory. An empty seat after the door closes is gone forever. So is an idle hour on an energized H100 rack.
• 85%+ of cost is fixed (servers, 10-year rack leases, 10-14% debt service). One more hour of compute costs pennies of power.
• Utilization is everything. Airlines break even around 80% load factor, a levered GPU cluster around 65-75%. The returns live in those last 25 percentage points.
• NVIDIA is Boeing and Airbus rolled into one. Powered shells and grid interconnects are the new airport slots.
• Wall St copied the aircraft financing playbook: take-or-pay contract plus servers in a bankruptcy-remote SPV, 70-80% LTV.

Part 1 of my blog post goes into a lot more detail:

https://t.co/0fghWVnGOU

text:
Ever wondered why some turbo cars go “STUTUTU” and others go “PSSSHH” when you lift off the throttle? 🤔

When the throttle snaps shut, the boosted air between the compressor and the throttle has nowhere to go.

🔁 STUTUTU (compressor surge / flutter): Without a blow-off valve, the trapped air pushes back against the compressor. It surges back and forth through the wheel in rapid pulses, and that makes the fluttering sound. The compressor wheel never spins backwards; only the air reverses.

💨 PSSSHH (blow-off valve): A blow-off valve sits between the compressor outlet and the throttle. When the throttle closes, the valve snaps open and vents the excess boost to the atmosphere, which makes the hiss. A recirculating valve sends that air back to the compressor inlet instead, so it’s much quieter.

Rotation and airflow are slowed down for clarity.

Inside the Machine: how machines really work, in 3D.

text:
Since 2020, the Pentagon has paid hundreds of millions of dollars in bonuses meant to make F-35s more ready to fly, and the fleet has become less ready since.

Part of the problem was what the money rewarded. Incentive fees were paid for performance that did not match what the services require, and the share of time the fleet could perform even one of its tasked missions fell from 67 percent in fiscal 2021 to 44 percent in fiscal 2025.

The Pentagon's $13.7 billion plan to improve readiness by 2030 depends on industry for more than $7 billion in additional parts and material, and GAO's assessment of that dependence is blunt: "capacity constraints persist for key parts."

The 10-year framework the Pentagon and Lockheed Martin announced in October targets both problems. It covers at least 850 U.S. jets plus fleet sustainment, Lockheed will put at least $7 billion of its own money into the program, and Under Secretary Michael Duffey said the deal works "by aligning financial incentives with actual performance." It still needs congressional authorization and funding before it can take effect.

The incentive record suggests that money buys F-35 readiness only when it pays for the right result, and both the reset and the framework rest on a second condition, which is that the parts have to exist. With about 1,700 more jets planned by the mid-2040s, supplier capacity may decide the outcome more than the size of the budget, because a growing fleet on the same constrained supply base could spread today's shortage across more aircraft. The framework's promises will be measured the same way the bonuses were, in mission capable rates.

The incentive record suggests that money buys F-35 readiness only when it pays for the right result, and both the reset and the framework rest on a second condition, which is that the parts have to exist. With about 1,700 more jets planned by the mid-2040s, supplier capacity may decide the outcome more than the size of the budget, because a growing fleet on the same constrained supply base could spread today's shortage across more aircraft. The framework's promises will be measured the same way the bonuses were, in mission capable rates.
